September 16, 2026
Jared Hoffmaster
St. Joseph County Board of Commissioners
Centreville, Michigan
RE: Reappointment of John Bippus whose term expires December 31, 2026
Dear Chairman Hoffmaster,
The St. Joseph County Road Commission respectfully requests that the St. Joseph County Board of Commissioners reappoint John Bippus to another term on the St. Joseph County Road Commission. In his time on the board, John has demonstrated his passion for the work by regularly attending township meetings, interacting with and gaining the respect of staff, attending local, regional and state road commission meetings, and advocating for best practices with both our board and the county board of commissioners.
Thank you for giving this request your consideration. The St. Joseph County Road Commission Board truly appreciates what John brings to the table and fears his absence will be felt on a number of levels. Retaining his knowledge and passion for the work we undertake is very important to our future and the future of our motoring public.
Warm regards,
St. Joseph County Road Commission Board of Road Commissioners
Rodney D. Chupp, Chairman
Vincent J. Mifsud, Vice-Chairman
